result.reason: The revision meets at least the fallback by covering affiliates and permitting transfer to an M&A successor, and it also appropriately includes contractors acting for Customer. The changes are confined to licence scope, transferability, and revocation. However, it does not reach the preferred termination position because the licence remains revocable upon any expiry or termination of the Agreement, not solely for uncured material breach, and it does not establish perpetual, irrevocable treatment for any paid-up licence. Drafting quality is weakened by leaving the subsequent provision stating that the licence “shall be revoked” unchanged, as well as the apparent section-reference mismatch between Sections 2 and 3.
